financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Registered direct offering of 2,560,000 ordinary shares to Armistice Capital at $5.00 per share (gross proceeds; net not given)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: The Offering closed on January 31, 2023. The gross proceeds from the Offering were approximately $12.8 million.

warrants.quote: Each of the Investor Warrants are exercisable for one ordinary share, have an initial exercise price of $5.85 and will become exercisable beginning six months from the date of issuance and will expire on January 27, 2028.
